nodes.label: KFV Freising Logo (Light/Color Version)
nodes.description: Official logo of Kreisfeuerwehrverband Freising e.V. (District Fire Department Association Freising). Horizontal layout with two heraldic shields on the left and organization name text on the right. Left shield: Freising district coat of arms with Bavarian blue-and-white diamond pattern (top-left quadrant), a crowned Moors head (bottom-left), a white rose (bottom-right), and a red background quadrant (top-right). Right shield: Red shield with white firefighting symbols - a Maltese-wheel/gear at bottom, two crossed axes, and a flame grenade/torch at top. Organization name in dark/black rounded sans-serif typeface reads 'Kreisfeuerwehrverband Freising e.V.' on two lines. Background is transparent/white. Primary brand colors: red, yellow/gold, blue-white (Bavarian), black.

nodes.label: Kreisfeuerwehrverband Freising e.V.
nodes.description: German registered association (e.V.) representing the district-level fire department federation for Freising, Bavaria. Abbreviation: KFV Freising.

nodes.label: Freising District Coat of Arms
nodes.description: Heraldic shield representing Landkreis Freising, Bavaria. Quartered: top-left Bavarian lozenges (blue and white diamonds), top-right red field, bottom-left crowned Moors head, bottom-right white rose on red. Traditional Bavarian regional heraldry.

nodes.label: Bavarian Fire Brigade Emblem
nodes.description: Red shield with white firefighting symbols: flame grenade/torch at top center, two crossed axes in middle, and a wheel/gear symbol at bottom. Standard Bavarian/German fire brigade heraldic emblem indicating firefighting organization affiliation.
